findings.issue: Paragraph 5.1 presents the gross new-office estimate as what the Department 'would require', although Section 82 transfers the funds, appropriations and plantilla positions of the CCC, the NDRRMC/OCD natural-disaster units and the DSWD; without netting or stating how many transferred positions count toward the 552 to 1,896 headcount, the headline overstates the new requirement.
findings.quote: shall include the corresponding funds and appropriations, plantilla positions, data, records, equipment, facilities, properties and other resources of the concerned government instrumentalities

findings.issue: Section 72 directs the DBM and COA to issue special fund rules, including longer validity and exemption from cash-based budgeting; Part V is silent on this direct obligation and on its conflict with standard budget rules.
findings.quote: providing for longer validity periods for funds and/or exemption from cash-based budgeting rules

findings.issue: Section 82 also lets the Department reorganize and reallocate transferred resources and positions on its own, which bypasses the staffing review that Part V (5.3) says should apply; this is not raised.
findings.quote: The Department shall have the power to reorganize or reallocate these resources and positions, as may be necessary

findings.issue: The Multi-Donor Trust Fund (Section 76) and the Department's power to receive and administer donations (Section 5) create funds outside the GAA, and the transfer of the People's Survival Fund (Section 75) is not discussed; none of these appear in the fiscal rows.
findings.quote: The Department shall create and manage, together with the Bureau of Treasury, a Multi-Donor Trust Fund

findings.issue: Section 34 allows the Department to require insurance of government-owned assets and charges LGU asset insurance to the LDRF; the cost to agencies and LGUs is not raised, nor is its interaction with the five percent set-aside under Section 73.
findings.quote: the Department may require, subject to existing laws and regulations and in coordination with the DOF, DBM, GSIS, and Insurance Commission, the insurance of government-owned assets

findings.issue: Part VII lists no item on the lump-sum Disaster Contingency Fund, the continuing appropriations under Section 71 or the special fund rules under Section 72, although Part V flags them as reducing budget detail and accountability; the funding issues in Part V are not carried into the recommendation.
findings.quote: shall be treated as Continuing Appropriations

findings.issue: The duplication entry names the OCD and the DND as the existing body with intent_to_abolish true, but Section 81 abolishes only the CCC and the NDRRMC and keeps the OCD; the entry could mislead the reviewer on which body is abolished.
findings.quote: Accordingly, the CCC and NDRRMC are hereby abolished.

findings.issue: Penalties of twelve to fifteen years' imprisonment and forfeiture apply to any person for a broad range of prohibited acts; proportionality and due process are not analysed anywhere, only a referral to LS.
findings.quote: The penalty of imprisonment of not less than twelve (12) years but not more than fifteen (15) years

findings.issue: LGU information systems and the DRRTI database collect profiles of vulnerable or marginalized groups and third-party data, but no part raises data privacy safeguards for these registries.
findings.quote: Establish a database that includes relevant information from other government agencies and third parties

findings.issue: Section 34 involves the DOF, BSP, LBP and GSIS in insurance pools and revolving funds, and the coverage table lists BMB-A and BMB-C for these agencies, but neither bureau is referred.
findings.quote: in collaboration with the DOF, BSP, LBP, GSIS, and the Insurance Commission, shall create, establish, and implement, among others, disaster insurance pools, revolving funds

findings.issue: Part VI states the signing date of RA No. 12231, which is not in the material supplied; it should be verified before release.
